subject: Trial asset stewardship playbook & MAP: delegation, acceptance, and restricted-use timeline
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference>
To: Alan Chu <alan@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial asset stewardship playbook & MAP: delegation, acceptance, and restricted-use timeline

Hi Alan —

Thanks again for agreeing to the 3-week trial. Per our call this morning I attached a short mutual action plan (MAP) and the initial prompt-pack and a small subset of test cases for BrightCart’s acceptance checks. High level:

- Goal: let BrightCart run a representative evaluation in your sandbox for two weeks, then do a 3-day acceptance window and sign-off.
- Stewardship: Redwood will host ephemeral assets in a gated sandbox; BrightCart will have scoped download access; usage limited to evaluation and not to be redistributed.
- Delegation: Redwood will provide a test harness and an S3 expiring token; BrightCart will run acceptance suite and provide the report.

Please review the MAP and the usage constraints in the attached PDF. A few specific asks:
1) Confirm the single point of contact for legal (I’ve cc’d your legal alias, but please confirm the individual).
2) Confirm whether you need an escrow path for the prompt-pack or if an ephemeral download with access logs is sufficient.
3) Can you commit to the acceptance window between Jun 15–17? We’ll aim to have the assets ingested into your staging environment by Jun 8.

Attachments:
- mutual-action-plan-BC-5742.pdf (MAP with timeline and custody rules)
- brightcart_promptpack_v1.zip (prompt pack, README inside)
- testcases_subset.csv (20 representative test cases)

Thanks — I’ll loop Marissa and Karthik in to finalize the operational handoffs.

Best,

Mina Haddad
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Trial asset stewardship playbook & MAP: delegation, acceptance, and restricted-use timeline

Mina —

Appreciate the docs and assets. A few quick items from our side:

- Legal needs a slightly expanded usage clause: specifically call out a prohibition on using the prompt-pack to train models outside the evaluation (we can provide suggested wording).
- Escrow vs ephemeral download: legal prefers an escrowing approach for prompt-packs for larger pilots; for this short trial they are open to the expiring-download + audit logs but want that in writing.
- Single POC: I’m the technical lead (alan@brightcart.com); legal point is Sarah Lim (sarah.lim@brightcart.com) — copying her below.
- Acceptance window: Jun 15–17 is OK but we need the ingestion by Jun 9 to allow for environment setup and one dry-run.

Two asks for Redwood ops: can you produce an access log sample and confirm data retention for the logs (we need 90 days)? Also, can the testcases be delivered with test IDs so our acceptance report maps to cases?

Forwarding to Sarah for legal on the usage wording.

Thanks,
Alan Chu
Director of ML Engineering, BrightCart
alan@brightcart.com

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is a minimally redlined MAP and an acceptance checklist tailored to the trial scope. Key points:

1) Training prohibition (one para) — added under Section 4: "Customer may not use any exchanged prompt-pack, test case corpus, or derivative content to train, fine-tune, or otherwise improve any machine learning model intended for production use outside this evaluation. Any use beyond the evaluation requires prior written consent from Redwood and may be subject to additional licensing."

2) Escrow: Added an escrow fallback paragraph. For this short trial, we are offering an ephemeral download with signed access logs; if BrightCart requests escrow we will provide steps and a recommended escrow vendor and split the escrow fee discussion under procurement.

3) Access logs: Ops confirmed we can retain logs 90 days for BC-5742; attached is a sample log and a short SL appendix describing retention and redaction steps.

4) Timeline: ingestion to BrightCart staging by Jun 9 (we’ll push to S3 with expiring tokens). Dry-run Jun 10. Acceptance window Jun 15–17. Post-acceptance: prompt-pack access revoked and sandbox snapshot retained for 30 days for audit.

Attachments included: mutual-action-plan-BC-5742_redlined.pdf, acceptance-checklist-BC-5742.pdf, access-log-sample.txt

Alan / Sarah — please confirm legal acceptance of the single-paragraph training prohibition and the ephemeral-download + 90-day logs approach. If you want escrow instead, let us know and we’ll follow the fallback process.

Mina — I’ll take lead on the ingestion runbook and will coordinate ops capacity with Rachel. Karthik, happy to take your language suggestions and fold them into the final doc.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head, Partner Onboarding, Redwood Inference
